scope: Evidence used to select mechanisms and exclusions; no source result is numerically transferred into the synthetic controllability screen except as an explicitly declared hypothesis.

sources.title: Optimization of passive superconductors for shaping stellarator magnetic fields
sources.role: Supports studying optimized passive superconducting coils for partial 3-D shaping and passive response.
sources.limit: Does not validate the SFR-3 loop geometry or its declared 55 percent transient attenuation.

sources.title: Stellarator fusion systems enabled by arrays of planar coils
sources.role: Supports individually controlled planar field-shaping arrays as a credible stellarator architecture.
sources.limit: Published configurations and field errors are not transferred to SFR-3.

sources.title: Error field measurement correction and heat flux balancing on Wendelstein 7-X
sources.role: Demonstrates practical error-field measurement and trim-coil correction in a stellarator.
sources.limit: W7-X response and capacity are machine-specific.

sources.title: Magnetic field of Wendelstein 7-X exact to a hundred-thousandth
sources.role: Establishes the importance and measurability of high field-geometry precision.
sources.limit: Precision achievement is not a reactor confinement or manufacturing guarantee.

sources.title: Efficient calculation of magnetic fields from ferromagnetic materials near strong electromagnets and application to stellarator coil optimization
sources.role: Supports including ferritic blanket magnetization in coil co-design rather than banning all magnetic structure by assumption.
sources.limit: Requires CAD-specific validation and does not guarantee minor effects for SFR-3.

sources.title: Towards joint optimization of stellarator coils and support structures
sources.role: Supports integrating support stress and displacement into coil optimization.
sources.limit: Preprint evidence; SFR-3 has not run the tool or reproduced the reported result.

sources.title: The performance of REBCO coated conductor during in situ cryogenic irradiation with fusion-spectrum neutrons
sources.role: Requires conservative real-time radiation lifetime treatment for REBCO.
sources.limit: One conductor and exposure protocol do not define a complete reactor lifetime.

sources.title: Design and Performance of Metal Hydride Composite Neutron Shields for Compact High-Power Fusion Reactors
sources.role: Supports retaining HfH1.7 composites as a solver-dependent magnet-shield candidate.
sources.limit: Published reductions are compact-tokamak configuration results and are not credited to SFR-3.

sources.title: ITER blanket
sources.role: Supports tungsten first-wall relevance and separates plasma-facing survival from confinement.
sources.limit: ITER materials and water-cooling decisions are not a direct reactor prescription.

sources.title: Demonstrating powder metallurgically produced long tungsten fiber-reinforced tungsten composite to serve as plasma-facing material
sources.role: Supports retaining tungsten-fiber-reinforced tungsten as a damage-resilience branch.
sources.limit: Does not establish reactor lifetime or make the wall a confinement system.

sources.title: Design and Analysis of the Open-Surface Slow Li Flow Divertor and Comparison to the Fast Li Flow Divertor
sources.role: Supports a local liquid-lithium divertor branch for recycling and heat exhaust.
sources.limit: The reported engineering limits do not imply core confinement improvement.

sources.title: Enhancement of Mid-/High-Z Impurity Transport by Continuous Li-granule Dropping in a Stellarator Plasma
sources.role: Shows lithium can materially alter impurity transport in a stellarator plasma.
sources.limit: Preprint and machine-specific; both beneficial and adverse impurity consequences require experiment.
